caveats: The dataset provides GeoJSON extracts of the feature services as a convenience for users. These extracts are updated semi-manually, when an automated process detects changes in the underlying feature services.
name: ukraine-logistics-datasets
notes:
**For real-time data downloads, go to [LogIE Ukraine operation page](https://logie.logcluster.org/?op=ukr-22-a)**

This dataset contains layers ESRI ArcGIS Online feature services for the following layers of interest to the logistics cluster in Ukraine:
- Entry and exit points
- Ports
- Supply routes
- Roads
- Railways
- Reception points
- Roads in Poland
